title: Nutty Flaky Syrian Tofu Kebabs
description: Indulgent Syrian dish featuring charred, flaky tofu, infused with the richness of Shaoxing wine, perfect for a vegan-friendly dinner

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium high heat
In a large bowl, whisk together Shaoxing wine, olive oil, pomegranate molasses, sumac, and salt
Add the tofu cubes to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes
Thread the marinated tofu cubes onto skewers
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking
Grill the tofu kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning frequently, until charred and flaky
In a small bowl, mix together pistachio meal and minced garlic
Sprinkle the pistachio garlic mixture over the grilled tofu kebabs
